title: High-Usage Addition on Early Termination of Closed-End Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Units
content:
# Training Q&A — The Usage Addition on a Closed-End Early Termination, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Rule.** For the early termination charge on a closed-end commercial unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease ended before its scheduled end date by a turn-in or by a recovery after an uncured default, the termination usage addition is $150 where the miles driven, the turn-in odometer less the odometer at delivery, exceed 82 miles for each day from the in-service date to the turn-in date, $75 where they exceed 66 but not 82 miles for each such day, and nothing where they do not exceed 66 miles a day.

**Q. What are the miles driven?**
A. The turn-in odometer recorded on the unit less the odometer at delivery recorded on the unit.

**Q. How many days are counted?**
A. The days from the unit's in-service date to its turn-in date (the date it was turned in or recovered, as the unit records it). Days between two dates count the later date but not the earlier one.

**Q. How is the comparison made?**
A. The miles driven are compared with 82 multiplied by those days, and with 66 multiplied by those days. "Exceed" means strictly more than.

| Miles driven compared with the days counted | Usage addition |
|---|---|
| more than 82 multiplied by the days | $150 |
| more than 66 multiplied by the days, but not more than 82 multiplied by the days | $75 |
| not more than 66 multiplied by the days | nothing |

**Q. Can you show both sides of each threshold?**
A. Hypothetical unit, 300 days from in-service date to turn-in date: 82 multiplied by 300 is 24600 and 66 multiplied by 300 is 19800.

| Miles driven | Usage addition |
|---|---|
| 24601 | $150 |
| 24600 | $75 (not more than 82 a day) |
| 19801 | $75 |
| 19800 | nothing (not more than 66 a day) |
